annotations.title: Send a 1:1 client a check-in or message

description: Use this when a Phorme coach wants to send one of their 1:1 clients a check-in, a form note (optionally with a video link) or a message. It posts to the client's coach thread in the app as the coach and sends them a notification. Send the coach's own words; never write as the coach without their yes. Set confirmation to true only after the coach approved exactly this text.

brain_id.description: The brain id of the coach's own build, for example "cameron".

client_id.description: The client_id of one of the coach's 1:1 clients, from coach_clients.

confirmation.description: True only after the coach approved this text.

video_url.description: An https link to a form video, for a form note.

name: coach_client_post
title: Send a 1:1 client a check-in or message
